schema.title: Hypertrophy Workout Sessions
schema.description: Complete targeted resistance training sessions focusing on upper/lower or push/pull splits.

schema.title: Daily Protein Intake
schema.description: Consume at least 1.6 to 2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight to support muscle growth.

schema.title: Caloric Target Adherence
schema.description: Hit your specific caloric surplus for bulking or deficit for cutting depending on your current phase.

schema.title: Cardio & Conditioning
schema.description: Perform zone 2 cardio or HIIT sessions to maintain low body fat and cardiovascular health.

schema.title: Daily Water Intake
schema.description: Drink at least 3.5 liters of water daily for optimal muscle hydration and recovery.

schema.title: Quality Sleep Duration
schema.description: Get a minimum of 7.5 to 8 hours of sleep per night for optimal muscle protein synthesis and recovery.

schema.title: Mobility and Stretching
schema.description: Perform targeted stretching or foam rolling to improve posture and range of motion for lifts.

schema.title: Physique Progress Photos
schema.description: Take weekly fasted front, back, and side photos under consistent lighting to track aesthetic changes.

schema.title: Daily Step Count
schema.description: Maintain a high daily non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) by hitting a daily step goal.
